marks.gloss_en: ריחק נגיחותיו -- חייב, קירב נגיחותיו -- לא כל שכן: if spaced gorings make it liable, gorings close together all the more so
כרבי מאיר, דאמר: קירב נגיחותיו לא כל שכן -- the decree for deaths close together follows R' Meir's view that close gorings are worse than spaced ones
R' Meir: [if an ox] spaced its gorings it is liable [as forewarned]; [if] it brought its gorings close together, all the more so!
אם גבירה לוקה, שפחה לא כל שכן: if the lady (Eretz Yisrael) is struck, the maidservant (Babylonia) all the more so
they told Rav Nachman: there is pestilence in Eretz Yisrael; he decreed a fast, saying: if the lady is struck, is not the maidservant all the more so!
טעמא דגבירה ושפחה -- since Rav Nachman's ground is lady-and-maid, it follows that maid-and-maid would not warrant a fast
והא אמרו ליה לשמואל: איכא מותנא בי חוזאי, גזר תעניתא! -- Shmuel fasted for a plague in another diaspora place
שאני התם, כיון דאיכא שיירתא דלוו ואתיא בהדיה -- caravans travel there and it comes with them (= p_shani_hatam_shayarta)
the reason is [that it is] lady and maidservant; but maidservant and maidservant -- no [fast]
אמרו ליה: לא קא מפסדן -- they are not destroying anything
זוודא אייתו בהדייהו? -- did they bring provisions with them? [they will eat the crops]
they told Rav Yehuda: locusts have come; he decreed a fast
אמרי ליה: והא מרחק! -- but Bei Chozai is far from here
ליכא מעברא הכא דפסיק ליה -- there is no crossing here that would cut it off
they told Shmuel: there is pestilence in Bei Chozai; he decreed a fast
[the 500-city:] in one day or in four days -- this is not a pestilence
Drokart, a city sending out five hundred foot-soldiers, had three dead in one day; Rav Nachman bar Rav Chisda decreed a fast
Rav Nachman bar Rav Chisda to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: let the master arise and come to us

and so we find with the Tent of Meeting in the wilderness: while it was pitched the Torah said 'that they put out of the camp every leper' (Num 5:2); once the curtains were rolled up, zavim and lepers were permitted to enter there
Rav Nachman bar Rav Chisda: if so, let me arise and come to the master
[in Sura there was pestilence, in Rav's neighbourhood none;] they thought it was because of Rav's great merit
[in Drokart there was a fire, in Rav Huna's neighbourhood none;] they thought it was through Rav Huna's great merit
they told Rav Yehuda: there is pestilence among the pigs; he decreed a fast
Abba the bloodletter would receive greetings from the heavenly academy every day
when he would let blood, he would place men apart and women apart
when a young scholar came to him he took no fee, and afterwards gave him coins, saying: go and restore yourself
